defect: Isolation opens when the source reset asserts: the previously nonzero payload is briefly exposed before its asynchronous reset-to-zero propagates. The receiver can sample that reset-induced pulse; during normal operation the wrong mask also forces every payload to zero.

labels.note: The inverted isolation exposes payload exactly while its independent raw warm reset is asserted, allowing asynchronous reset transitions to reach the active receiver.
